chiru: Khan ama na thampui pang ah rawi rupan a
english: Again He began to teach by the sea

chiru: Aman ha na teithuhai in thu tamtak rihil
english: Then He taught them many things by parables

chiru: Ama na amani dieng ruti, Pathien Ram thua ruka rihawng
english: And He said to them, To you it has been given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God

chiru: Nikhawmaduak khan, ama na amani dieng ruti, Khawmaduak thampui ralam tieng inkal iau
english: On the same day, when evening had come, He said to them, Let us cross over to the other side

chiru: Khan ama rathoi a thli le thampui tieng ruti, Khawp roh
english: Then He arose and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, Peace be still

chiru: Khan amani na riti tawk ngeia aningai ruti
english: And they feared exceedingly, and said to one another, Who can this be
